stories.title: SON DAKİKA... Rasim Ozan Kütahyalı, 'ifadeye çağrıldım' dedi: Başsavcılık yalanladı

en.title: Rasim Ozan Kütahyalı says 'I was called to give a statement': Chief Prosecutor denies it
en.summary: Rasim Ozan Kütahyalı claimed he was summoned to testify regarding former MIT official Kaşif Kozinoğlu's 2011 prison death. The Chief Prosecutor's office denied this claim.

stories.title: Kaşif Kozinoğlu soruşturması... Rasim Ozan Kütahyalı 'İfadeye çağrıldım' dedi, Başsavcılık yalanladı

en.title: Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation... Rasim Ozan Kütahyalı says 'I was called to give a statement', Chief Prosecutor denies
en.summary: During a Kaşif Kozinoğlu investigation, Rasim Ozan Kütahyalı claimed he was summoned to testify at Silivri Courthouse. The Chief Prosecutor denied this, stating Kütahyalı had only visited the courthouse.

stories.title: 'Sokağın hakkını verin' tehdidi! Suç örgütü adına oto galeriyi kundaklayan 3 kişiye gözaltı

en.title: 'Give the street its due' threat! 3 suspects detained for arson attack on auto dealership on behalf of criminal organization
en.summary: In Antalya, three of four suspects were captured and detained for setting fire to an auto dealership on behalf of a criminal organization after threatening the owner with demands for protection money.

stories.title: Tribünlerdeki Öcalan sloganları Bahçeli'nin danışmanını kızdırdı

en.title: Öcalan slogans in the stands angered Bahçeli's advisor
en.summary: Slogans chanted in stadium stands against terrorist leader Öcalan and the political process upset an advisor to MHP leader Devlet Bahçeli.

stories.title: Türkiye'de en çok kazandıran meslekler belli oldu: Zirvede hangi alan bulunuyor?

en.title: Turkey's highest-earning professions identified: Which field is at the top?
en.summary: A report on 2026 projections shows which professions in Turkey will offer the highest incomes, with law, aviation, and information technology fields leading the list.

stories.title: Bahçeli'nin danışmanından tribünlerdeki 'Öcalan' sloganına tepki: 'Bunu ilk bulan kimdir?'

en.title: Reaction from Bahçeli's advisor to 'Öcalan' slogans in stadiums: 'Who came up with this first?'
en.summary: An advisor to MHP leader Devlet Bahçeli responded to slogans chanted in stadiums, calling for investigation into who originated and organized the chanting across multiple provinces.

stories.title: “Sokağın hakkını verin” tehdidi! Oto galeriyi kundaklayan şüpheliler yakalandı

en.title: "Give the street its due" threat: Suspects who firebombed auto dealership caught
en.summary: Authorities in Antalya arrested suspects accused of threatening a car dealership owner with demands for payment while acting on behalf of a criminal organization.

stories.title: Gülistan Doku soruşturmasında 6'ıncı dalga operasyonu: 4 tutuklama

en.title: Sixth wave operation in Gülistan Doku investigation: 4 arrests
en.summary: In the sixth phase of the investigation into missing university student Gülistan Doku in Tunceli, four of eleven suspects detained were formally arrested, bringing total detentions to 36.

stories.title: Türkiye'de 2026 yılının en çok kazandıran meslekleri belli oldu

en.title: Turkey's highest-earning professions in 2026 have been determined
en.summary: According to research by Boğaziçi Institute, notary work leads Turkey's highest-income professions in 2026 with average monthly earnings of 456,000 TL, followed by piloting at 350,000 TL and software engineering at 348,000 TL.

stories.title: Türkiye'de 2026’nın en çok kazandıran meslekleri açıklandı: Zirvede sürpriz değişim

en.title: Turkey's highest-earning professions in 2026 announced: Surprising change at the top
en.summary: According to Boğaziçi Institute's 2026 income research, a ranking of the ten professions with the highest average monthly earnings in Turkey has been revealed, with notable changes in the top positions.

stories.title: Erzurum'da gizemli yol: Araçlar vites boştayken yokuş yukarı çıkıyor!

en.title: Mysterious road in Erzurum: Vehicles climb uphill with engine off and transmission in neutral
en.summary: Researchers discovered a 300-meter section of road near Erzurum's Konaklı Ski Center where vehicles move uphill despite having their engines off and transmissions in neutral.

stories.title: Gülistan Doku soruşturmasında 4 zanlı daha tutuklandı

en.title: 4 more suspects arrested in Gülistan Doku investigation
en.summary: Four additional suspects have been arrested in connection with the disappearance of university student Gülistan Doku from Tunceli, who has been missing since January 5, 2020.

stories.title: DTÖ'den küresel ekonomiye uyarı: Hareketsiz kalmanın bedeli ağır

en.title: WTO warns global economy: Cost of inaction is severe
en.summary: The World Trade Organization cautioned that weakened cooperation in global trade could impose significant costs on the world economy. A strengthened trade system could generate 3 trillion dollars in economic gains by 2050, while fragmentation into geopolitical blocs or declining multilateral cooperation could cause substantial production and export losses.

stories.title: Fethiye'de iş yerinde baba ve iki çocuğu ölü bulundu

en.title: Father and two children found dead at workplace in Fethiye
en.summary: A father and his two children, ages 10 and 6, were discovered dead at a workplace in Fethiye, Muğla. An investigation has been launched and autopsies have been ordered.

stories.title: Elche Real Madrid maçı ne zaman, saat kaçta, hangi kanalda? Arda Güler oynayacak mı, ilk 11'de mi?

en.title: When is the Elche Real Madrid match, what time, which channel? Will Arda Güler play, will he start?
en.summary: Real Madrid faces Elche in La Liga's sixth week, seeking their fifth victory. Questions surround whether Arda Güler will participate and his starting lineup status for the match.

stories.title: Çip ihracatında izin krizi: Süre iki aya, maliyet yüzde 20’ye çıktı

en.title: Chip export permit crisis: Timeline extends to two months, costs rise 20 percent
en.summary: South Korea's tightened export controls on chip equipment have impacted manufacturers, with approval times extending from days to over two months. Design modifications made by companies to work around restrictions have increased costs by up to 20 percent.

stories.title: Beşiktaş-Olimpik Marsilya maçının hakemi belli oldu

en.title: Referee for Beşiktaş-Olympique Marseille Match Determined
en.summary: Italian referee Andrea Colombo will officiate Beşiktaş's home match against Olympique Marseille in the first week of the UEFA Europa League.
